thread:
maya: quick thought — can we try telemetry-driven defaults for per-route saved views? e.g. route presets that pick model/profile based on traffic shape + 95p latency targets. keeps configs simpler for PMs.
aj: interesting. do you mean auto-suggesting a preset when someone opens the route view? or migrating existing saved queries?
maya: auto-suggest when opening, + a CTA to apply. not doing silent migration. goal = reduce manual tuning for common routes (low-latency vs high-throughput).
kelsey: +1. couple UX Qs: how do we communicate why a preset is suggested? and can users pin/lock it?
maya: show small badge "Suggested by telemetry" with a one-line rationale (e.g. "high qps, bursty short prompts — suggest batch-optimized profile"). pin should be allowed; suggestion only until they pick a preference.
sanjay: from infra side we can compute heuristics offline daily. rough algorithm: for each route: compute p50/p95 lat, avg tokens, qps; if qps > X and p95 < Y -> recommend batching profile; else if p95 > Z -> recommend lower-latency model variant. will need to surface confidence score.
aj: need an API shape for this so console can fetch suggestions. proposal: GET /routes/:id/suggestions -> [{"preset_id":"..","reason":"string","confidence":0.0}] JSON small. cacheable per-route, TTL 24h.
kelsey: UI would like a compact card in the right rail with 1) suggested preset name 2) reason 3) apply / dismiss / pin buttons. dismiss to suppress for 7 days.
maya: what about quotas/cost? we don't want to suggest expensive configs by default. include cost_delta estimate and a toggle to prefer cost-safe suggestions.
sanjay: we can add cost_delta field from telemetry (avg tokens * price_per_token for variant). but price_per_token may vary by model/quantization — infra can expose a lookup.
aj: also, need product signal in telemetry: if suggestion applied, emit event suggestion.applied with preset_id and user_id so we can measure adoption & quality.
maya: agree — also emit suggestion.dismissed. metrics: adoption rate, rollback, p95 change, cost change.
dev-bot: reminder: deploy job #6428 scheduled tonight — if we're going to add API endpoints, coordinate with eng-runtime for rate limits. :robot_face:
kelsey: ok sounds like next steps: 1) design API contract (aj + sanjay) 2) mockups for right-rail card (kelsey + maya) 3) telemetry job to generate suggestions + confidence (sanjay) 4) analytics events and dashboards (maya). I'll create a quick RFC.
maya: thanks — I'll drop an RFC draft in #product-docs and we can iterate. @aj @sanjay can you comment there by EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:
